Coram : TARUN CHATTERJEE*, AFTAB ALAM
Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881: A B ss.145(1) and (2) -Affidavit of a deponent is in the nature c of examination-in-Chief - On being summoned under s. 145(2), complainant or his witness whose evidence is given on affidavit is not required to depose in examination-in-chief all over again - and (2) - Applicability to the proceedings D pending on 6.2.2003, the date on which these sections were inserted in the Act - Held: Applicable as these provisions are procedural and not substantive in nature. s.145(1) - Right of accused to give evidence on affidavit E - Held: s.145(1) confers
